description.value: Egg Bomb is a breakfast and brunch café in Langley serving creative fare including crodises (croissant-donut hybrids), croffles, French toast, sandwiches, and salads alongside an extensive coffee and drink menu. The restaurant offers dine-in seating with advance reservations and phone-based takeout orders. It would serve as a refuelling stop for cyclists riding along the Fraser Highway corridor.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: wave (5 spaces) at 22m. Total: 5 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business is active with a live reservation system, contact page, and online ordering interface. The contact page corroborates the OSM address (301-20300 Fraser Hwy, Langley BC V3A 4E6) and provides a phone number absent from OSM. The menu page explicitly lists Pickup and Dine-In options, confirming takeout availability, but no cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi) are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM cuisine tag is 'donut', but the menu shows a broader brunch/café concept (crodises, croffles, English muffins, sandwiches, salads, coffee drinks) with no donuts explicitly listed — the tag appears outdated or inaccurate.
OSM record contains no phone number; phone (604-200-6525) sourced from website only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The business is a legitimate food & drink establishment on a cycling corridor, but none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) could be confirmed from the website. On-site verification is needed before listing.

wow_evidence: breakfast and brunch café in Langley serving creative fare including crodises (croissant-donut hybrids)
